Binomial Regression

Alex Berk

Prepare data

# variables to include:
c = c("Chlorophyll", "Regions", "Date","Year", "Month",  "season","SAC",
       "EXPORT","OUT", "DissAmmonia",
       "lagDissAmmonia", "TotPhos","DissNitrateNitrite", 
       "Temperature","Secchi", 
       "Conductivity","season_num", "DissOrthophos", "clam_step",
      "logDissNitrateNitrite","logDissAmmonia","logDissOrthophos","logConductivity","logSAC","logOUT","logEXPORT")#, "Biomass","Grazing_rate","Filtration_rate", "SJR","lagSJR", "Index","lagIndex")

df <- read.csv("Data/regional_integrated_dataset4.csv" )

df$Date = as.Date(df$Date)

# 1979 is the start of the study period.
df <- subset(df,df$Date >= "1979-01-01" & df$Date < "2023-01-01")

# Changing categorical variables to factors
df$Regions = as.factor(df$Regions)
df$season = as.factor(df$season)
df$season_num = as.numeric(df$season)


#Replacing clam variables with a step function (pre/post potamocorbula introduction to the Bay in 1987)
df <- df%>%mutate(clam_step=if_else(Year>1987, "post clam", "pre clam")) 
df$clam_step <- as.factor(df$clam_step)


# log transforming some variables to better visualize
df$logDissNitrateNitrite <- log(df$DissNitrateNitrite)
df$logDissAmmonia <- log(df$DissAmmonia)
df$logDissOrthophos <- log(df$DissOrthophos)
df$logConductivity <- log(df$Conductivity)
df$logSAC <- log(df$SAC)
df$logOUT <- log(df$OUT)
df$logEXPORT <- log(df$EXPORT)

# Dropping NAs from the dataset, only for dredging.

 df <- subset(df, select = c) #%>%
    #drop_na()
# Make sure all dates are present for lag variables later on.
 df %>% complete(Date = seq(min(Date), max(Date), by = "1 month"))

Remove outliers based on z-score

removing outliers based on z-score, assuming the log transformations of the targeted variables have a normal distribution.

-3 - 3 is a commonly used range beyond which values are considered outliers. https://statsandr.com/blog/outliers-detection-in-r/#z-scores

clean_df_z <- df 

clean_df_z$logDissAmmonia[abs(scale(clean_df_z$logDissAmmonia)) > 3.29] <- NA

clean_df_z$logDissNitrateNitrite[abs(scale(clean_df_z$logDissNitrateNitrite)) > 3.29] <- NA

clean_df_z$logDissOrthophos[abs(scale(clean_df_z$logDissOrthophos)) > 3.29] <- NA

outliers_z <- anti_join(df, clean_df_z)
## Joining with `by = join_by(Chlorophyll, Regions, Date, Year, Month, season,
## SAC, EXPORT, OUT, DissAmmonia, lagDissAmmonia, TotPhos, DissNitrateNitrite,
## Temperature, Secchi, Conductivity, season_num, DissOrthophos, clam_step,
## logDissNitrateNitrite, logDissAmmonia, logDissOrthophos, logConductivity,
## logSAC, logOUT, logEXPORT)`
print(paste("rows changed:",nrow(outliers_z)))
## [1] "rows changed: 25"
df <- clean_df_z

Separate Dataset Regionally

May need to separate by flow as well, check from Ryan

df_flow <- df[,c("Date","Regions","SAC", "OUT",  "EXPORT", "logEXPORT","logOUT","logSAC")]

df_no_flow <- df[,!(names(df) %in% c("SAC", "logSAC", "OUT", "logOUT", "EXPORT", "logEXPORT"))]

r <- unique(df_no_flow$Regions)
region_list <- list()
for (region in r){
  df_regional <- df_no_flow %>% filter(Regions == region)
  region <- gsub(" ","",region)
  region_list[[region]] <- df_regional
}

Impute data

regional_imp <- list()
for (region_name in as.character(names(region_list))){
  current_df <- region_list[[region_name]]
  predictors <- quickpred(current_df)
  imp <- mice(current_df,seed = 123, print=F, predictorMatrix = predictors)
  new_name <- paste0(region_name, "_imp")
  regional_imp[[new_name]]<- imp
}

Make combined imputed datasets

regional_imp_dfs <- list()
action_seq <- as.list(seq(1,5))
for (region_imp in as.character(names(regional_imp))){
      current_imp <- regional_imp[[region_imp]]
      for (i in action_seq){
        df_new <- complete(current_imp,action = i, include=FALSE)
        df_new <- left_join( df_new,df_flow, by=c("Date","Regions"))
        new_name <- paste0(region_imp, "_df", i)
        regional_imp_dfs[[new_name]]<- df_new}}

Add Lag terms to imputed datasets

#  Create the 3 month lag
df_list_lag <- lapply(regional_imp_dfs, function(y){

  lagged_df <- y %>%
    # Group by region so completion happens independently per region
    group_by(Regions) %>%
    
    # Sort chronologically within each group
    arrange(Regions, Date) %>%
    
    # Lag all numeric columns by 3 rows
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ lag(.x, n = 3), .names = "lag{col}")) %>%

    ungroup()
})

Combine regional imputed datsets

### df1 (save natural scale as dataset for later calculations)
df1_nat <- distinct(rbind(df_list_lag$Central_imp_df1, df_list_lag$Confluence_imp_df1,
             df_list_lag$NorthDelta_imp_df1, df_list_lag$South_imp_df1,df_list_lag$SuisunBay_imp_df1))

Add bloom threshold to imputation 1

#Binary transformation of bloom absence/presence
bloom_thresholds <- df1_nat %>%
  group_by(Regions) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T),sd=sd(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T)) %>%
  mutate(bloom_thr = mean + sd) %>%
  select(-mean,-sd)

#Imputation 1 
df1_nat <- df1_nat %>%
  merge(bloom_thresholds,by="Regions",all.x=T) %>%
  mutate(bloom = case_when(Chlorophyll > bloom_thr ~ 1,
                           Chlorophyll < bloom_thr ~ 0))

bloom_season_imp1 <- df1_nat %>%
  group_by(season,Regions) %>%
  summarize(blooms = sum(bloom)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Regions,values_from = blooms) %>%
  mutate(all_regions = sum(across(Central:`Suisun Bay`)))
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by season and Regions.
## ℹ Output is grouped by season.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(season, Regions))` for per-operation grouping
##   (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
flow_season_imp1 <- df1_nat %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarize(SAC = mean(SAC),OUT=mean(OUT),EXPORT=mean(EXPORT))

base::paste0("number of blooms: ",toString(sum(df1_nat$bloom))) 
## [1] "number of blooms: 258"

Z-score

# z-score standardizing the dataset for easier comparison of predictors. This facilitates comparison of effect sizes between variables.

df1 <- df1_nat %>% mutate(across(!c(bloom,Regions,season,Date,Month, Year, season_num, clam_step), ~as.vector(scale(.))))

sum contrasts

contrasts(df1$season) <- contr.sum(nlevels(df1$season))
colnames(contrasts(df1$season)) <- c("Autumn","Spring","Summer")

Model Fit and Summaries

Use Ryan’s top models from the Global GAM result to run a binomial GAM: Models 4 and 6 with PO4. Update 7/15/2026: removed regions random effect.

bm3.po4.imp1.glm1 - temperature

Orthophosphos with OUT - temp no season

bm3.po4.imp1.glm1 <- glm(bloom ~ logDissAmmonia + 
                      logDissNitrateNitrite + 
                      laglogDissNitrateNitrite + 
                      Temperature + 
                      logConductivity + 
                      # season + 
                      # (logOUT*season) + 
                      clam_step + 
                      logOUT + 
                      laglogOUT + 
                      laglogDissAmmonia + 
                      logDissOrthophos + 
                      laglogDissOrthophos,
             family=binomial(link = "logit"),data=df1)

summary(bm3.po4.imp1.glm1)

Function for LD Plots

Creates the LD curves for each parameter and model

ldcurve <- function(model_name,param,xlab_name="parameter label") {
  
  # model_name <- bm4.po4.imp1.glm1
  # param <- "laglogSAC"
  # xlab_name <- "Seasonal Lag - SAC"
  
  #STEP 1: Create a dataframe that holds all parameters but one constant at their median.
  
  #start with a dataframe that sequences between the min/max of the selected parameter and holds the factors constant. Factors can be held at any variable, from my experimenting the results appear to be the same. 
  df_pred <- data.frame(
    parameter = seq(min(df1[[param]],na.rm=T), max(df1[[param]],na.rm=T), length.out = 1000),
    clam_step = as.factor("post clam"),
    season = as.factor("Spring")) %>%
    rename(!!param := parameter)
  
  #Expand all the factors so that they reflect the same factors in the original dataset. 
  df_pred$season = fct_expand(df_pred$season,c("Autumn","Spring","Summer","Winter"))
  df_pred$clam_step = fct_expand(df_pred$clam_step,c("post clam","pre clam"))
  
  #Create a vector of water quality parameters from the selected model. Remove blooms because that's what we're predicting.
  model_params <- (model.frame(model_name)) %>%
  select(-bloom)

  #Find the median of all the non-selected parameters in the the z-scored dataframe.
  df_mean <- df1 %>%
    select(-clam_step,-Regions,-Chlorophyll,-Date,-Year,-Month,-season,-bloom_thr,-bloom,-c(all_of(param))) %>%
    group_by() %>%
    summarize_all(~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) 

  #bind the sequenced dataframe and the median dataframe. 
  df_pred <- bind_cols(df_pred,df_mean) %>%
    select(colnames(model_params)) #selects only parameters in the model 
  
  #STEP 2: Predict blooms based on the datframe you created.
  df_pred <- as.data.frame(predict(model_name, newdata = df_pred, type = "link",se.fit=T)) %>%
    select(1,2) %>%
    mutate(fit_prob=plogis(fit),
           hi = plogis(fit+1.96*se.fit), #upper 95% CI
           lo = plogis(fit-1.96*se.fit)  #lower 95% CI
           ) %>%  
    bind_cols(df_pred)

  #summarize the statistics of the natural (pre-z-scored) dataframe. 
  df1_stats <- df1_nat %>%
    select(Date,DissAmmonia:laglogSAC,-clam_step,-season_num) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = !"Date",names_to = "Parameter") %>%
    group_by(Parameter) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(value,na.rm=T),sd = sd(value,na.rm=T))
  
  #transform the selected parameter to reflect the natural values. 
  df_pred <- df_pred %>%
    mutate(paramnat = as.numeric(df1_stats[df1_stats$Parameter == param,3])*df_pred[[param]]+as.numeric(df1_stats[df1_stats$Parameter == param,2])) %>%
  mutate(paramnat = case_when(grepl("log",param) == T ~ exp(paramnat),
                              .default = paramnat)) %>%
  rename(!!paste0(param,"_nat") := paramnat)

  #Plot the LD curve
  plot(df_pred[[paste0(param,"_nat")]],df_pred$fit,ylab="Probability of Phytoplankton Bloom", xlab= xlab_name,type='n',
       ylim = c(0,max(df_pred$hi)))
  #polygon
  polygon(c(rev(df_pred[[paste0(param,"_nat")]]),df_pred[[paste0(param,"_nat")]]),c(rev(df_pred$hi),df_pred$lo),
          col='grey80',border=NA)
  #add LD line
  lines(df_pred[[paste0(param,"_nat")]],df_pred$fit_prob)
  #add high interval
  lines(df_pred[[paste0(param,"_nat")]],df_pred$hi,lty='dashed',col='red')
  #add low interval
  lines(df_pred[[paste0(param,"_nat")]],df_pred$lo,lty='dashed',col='red')
  abline(h = 0.05,lty='dashed')
}

Function for LD10 Values across all parameters

findLD <- function(model_name,ld_val = 10) {
  df1_stats2 <- df1_nat %>%
  select(colnames(model.frame(model_name)),-bloom) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric),names_to = "Parameter") %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(value,na.rm=T),sd = sd(value,na.rm=T))

ld10tab <- as.data.frame(matrix(data = NA,ncol=nrow(df1_stats2),nrow=1))
colnames(ld10tab) <- df1_stats2$Parameter 

for(i in colnames(ld10tab)) {
  #dataframe with the range of a parameter value and holding the others constant
  df_pred2 <- data.frame(
    parameter = seq(min(df1[[i]],na.rm=T), max(df1[[i]],na.rm=T), length.out = 1000),
    clam_step = as.factor("post clam"),
    season = as.factor("Spring")) %>%
    rename(!!i := parameter)
  
  #expand factors
  df_pred2$season = fct_expand(df_pred2$season,c("Autumn","Spring","Summer","Winter"))
  df_pred2$clam_step = fct_expand(df_pred2$clam_step,c("post clam","pre clam"))
  
  #find median of all other factors
  df_mean <- df1 %>%
    group_by() %>%
    summarize_if(where(is.numeric), ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    select(c(colnames(ld10tab)),-c(all_of(i)),-bloom) #selects only parameters in the model 
  
  df_pred2 <- bind_cols(df_pred2,df_mean)
  
  #predict response scale
  df_pred2$predicted <- predict(model_name, newdata = df_pred2, type = "response")
  
  ld10 <- approx(x = df_pred2$predicted, y = df_pred2[[i]], xout = ld_val/100)$y
  ld10_nat<-ld10*df1_stats2[df1_stats2$Parameter == i,3]+df1_stats2[df1_stats2$Parameter == i,2]
  ld10tab[[i]] <- as.numeric(ld10_nat)
}
# ld10tab <- ld10tab %>%
#   mutate(across(starts_with("l"),~ exp(.x,na.rm=T)))
ld10tab <- as.data.frame(t(ld10tab)) %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  rename("Parameters"= 1,
         "LD" = 2) %>%
  mutate(LD = case_when(grepl("log",Parameters) & !is.na(LD) ~ exp(LD),
                                  .default = LD)) %>%
  rename(!!paste0("LD_",ld_val) := LD)
return(ld10tab)
}
